# PROCESS — iteration 1 (seed → cand_0001)

Reward = DB_match × COMMUNICATE (product; either 0 zeroes the task). Action-trace
checks are DIAGNOSTIC only. Parent val = 0.300 (pass: 8, 19, 37; fail: 11,12,17,22,23,25,40).

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Post-consent action STALL | 40, 25 | agent narrates plan, asks "reply yes", user says "Yes.###STOP###", episode ends before ANY write is called | BEHAVIORAL (tau2 quirk) | prompt: execute-on-next-step + treat explicit complete instruction as confirmation |
| 2 | Wrong-reservation selection | 17, 22 | agent grabs FIRST reservation instead of matching the user's route; acts on SEA→DFW when user wanted NYC→Chicago (FQ8APE, EWR→ORD) | CAPABILITY-GAP | code: NEW get_user_reservations loop tool + prompt route-match |
| 3 | Info already on file, refused | 22, 11 | agent demands a DOB (already in profile) / a payment method, blocking the write | BEHAVIORAL/KNOWLEDGE | prompt: use on-file data |
| 4 | Payment/refund method not on file | 11 | user demanded refund to a credit card NOT on file (only gift_card on file); agent looped then transferred, never wrote | DECISION | prompt narrowing: use the eligible on-file method, don't transfer |
| 5 | Budget-as-total + act-before-validate | 12 | read "$650" as per-passenger, upgraded ($1200) when gold refuses; botched revert corrupted DB | KNOWLEDGE+BEHAVIORAL | prompt: compute full cost first (calculate), budget is total, decline if over |
| 6 | Communicate exact totals | 23 | DB already CORRECT (1.0); COMMUNICATE=0 — omitted certificate total ($1000) and stated wrong card total ($1219 vs $1286) | BEHAVIORAL/KNOWLEDGE | prompt: sum with calculate, state each requested total |

## Changes made this iteration
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2 | NEW loop/read tool | tools.py `get_user_reservations` | one call returns every reservation with origin/destination/cabin/flights so the agent matches by route instead of guessing the first; general over any user | yes — new READ tool, no existing behavior changed |
| 1 | prompt (execute/confirm) | policy.md "Execute the action — never stall" | forbids ending a turn on a redundant "please confirm" when the user gave an explicit complete allowed instruction; mandates the write on the next step | DB-neutral (see verify) |
| 2 | prompt (locate) | policy.md "Finding the correct reservation" | use get_user_reservations + list_all_airports to match route; never take first | only fires when locating by route |
| 3 | prompt (data on file) | policy.md "Information already on file" | DOB/passenger details come from get_user_details/get_reservation_details; don't re-ask | additive |
| 5,6 | prompt (money) | policy.md "Money, budgets, and reporting amounts" | compute with calculate; budget is TOTAL not per-pax; decline if over cap; state exact per-request totals | additive knowledge |
| 1,3 | prompt (copy) | policy.md Book flight "Booking a trip that copies…" | reuse existing reservation's flights/dates/cabin/type instead of re-asking (reduces over-collection stall) | only when copying |
| 4 | prompt (payment on file) | policy.md Modify-flight Payment | if requested method not on file, use eligible on-file method; don't transfer | 8/19/37 use on-file methods → never fires |

## Verify-the-fix (one line per change)
- get_user_reservations: ran live on omar_rossi_1241 → returns 4 rows incl. FQ8APE EWR→ORD (the NYC→Chicago target for 17/22); ran on all 3 passing users (sophia_silva_7557, aarav_ahmed_6699, olivia_gonzalez_2305) + ivan_muller_7015/chen_lee_6825/james_patel_9828 → no error, correct routes. Registration verified: get_tools() lists 15 tools incl. the new one; t.tools schema builds. Docstring uses no `Example:` header (avoids the registration-break pitfall).
- Route-match prompt: FQ8APE is the only reservation to ORD → rule deterministically disambiguates; passing tasks are given ids so rule is dormant.
- Execute/confirm prompt: BLAST RADIUS is behavioral but reward is DB×COMMUNICATE and action-checks are diagnostic — passing tasks 8/19/37 pass on final DB state, which is unchanged whether or not a redundant confirm turn happens. The "allowed by policy" + "have every required detail" clauses preserve 19's basic-economy modification REFUSAL and 37's two cancel REFUSALS (those are not "allowed", so the agent still refuses). This is the one edit whose blast radius is the whole confirm-class; kept because it is DB-neutral for the passing class and is the only lever for the 40/25 stall.
- Info-on-file / copy-reservation / money / payment-on-file prompts: each fires only on its violating condition; verified against passing tasks — 8 pays certificate_8045380 (on file, amount 348 correct), 37 pays credit_card_9074831 (on file, +$597 correct), 19 refunds to gift card on file. None of these rules change those actions.

## Process & features used
- Subagents: 4 parallel general-purpose agents diagnosed clusters (11/17/22; 12/40; 23/25) and the passing baseline (8/19/37) concurrently, then merged.
- Prior iterations: none (first iteration; RUNMAP/LEDGER empty). Cross-run memory note confirmed reward=DB×COMMUNICATE and that the 40/25 stall is largely a tau2 termination quirk.

## Good things to PRESERVE
- get_user_reservations as the route-matching entry point.
- The DB×COMMUNICATE framing: DB-correct tasks (like 23) can still be zero on communication — prompt rules that make the agent STATE exact totals are real gains.
- Basic-economy flight-modification refusal (task 19) and cancel-refusal (task 37) must stay intact — do NOT add a blanket "block basic economy" guard: task 17's gold is a cabin change on a basic-economy reservation (allowed).

## Deliberately skipped
- Payment auto-correct guard in book_reservation (memory suggested it): NOT REAL this iteration — no failing task is stranded by the payment-sum raise (task 8, which hits it, is passing; failing bookings 25/40 never called book; 23 booked correctly).
- Baggage free-allowance recompute: no failing task's root cause is baggage math.
- Blanket "block basic-economy modification" guard: would break task 17 gold (cabin-only change on basic economy is allowed).
